propositions: The shutdown drain waits only for the webhook queue to empty via queue.join(), not for in-flight reconciler reviews, causing reconcile_once's inline review_and_vote to be cancelled within shutdown_cancel_seconds (~10s) instead of the full shutdown_drain_seconds budget.

Any container stop outside the autodeploy path (manual docker compose restart, host reboot, systemd stop, autodeploy rollback) kills in-flight reconciler reviews with no drain protection, and the reconciler is the retry path for other killed reviews.

The lifespan must request the reconciler to stop accepting new work before draining, then wait on voter.in_flight_reviews() gated by review_in_flight() within a single shared shutdown_drain_seconds budget, to prevent new reviews from extending the shutdown indefinitely.
The reconciler's shutdown break path must record remaining candidates in held_back to preserve the low-water-mark cursor invariant and avoid permanently skipping gap patchsets.

The stop flag (_stop_requested) must clear at the end of shutdown after the bounded cancel phase, not at startup, to prevent post-shutdown reconcile_once calls from silently declining all candidates while reporting them as scanned.
